calculation.description: Average five-session close-location value, scaled by trailing 20-session realized return volatility. Positive values indicate persistent closes near the high relative to recent risk; negative values indicate closes near the low. The signal uses only information available at the completed observation date and predicts the next-session return for admission. The 5-day horizon result is retained as decay/profiling evidence.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was negative and stable in magnitude across 2020-2026, with a positive 2027-2028 regime; small 15-asset cross-section and 75.21% average coverage warrant conservative portfolio weighting. Absolute daily IC and ICIR exceed benchmark admission gates.
